features.title: Agent CLI sessions browser
features.summary: One page lists the sessions other agent CLIs recorded on this machine (Claude Code under ~/.claude/projects, Codex under ~/.codex/sessions), newest first, with title, working directory, branch, prompts, tool calls and token totals; filters them by agent and text, searches their messages, and opens one as a read-only transcript with tool calls, thinking and context messages behind toggles.
reach: expect text "Threads other agent CLIs recorded on this machine*"

configuration.constraints: Environment of the DSH Host; Claude Code logs are read from <dir>/projects, the same override Claude Code itself honours.
Environment of the DSH Host; Codex rollouts are read from <dir>/sessions, the same override Codex itself honours.

failureModes: A missing agent folder is reported as not found with the command that creates it, and the other agent still lists.
A malformed or oversized log line is skipped without dropping the rest of the file or the index.
A half-written last line of a running session is left for the next pass instead of being parsed early.
A missing or unreadable index file is rebuilt by re-reading the logs; the agent logs are never written.
Message search is time- and session-bounded and says how many sessions it scanned when it stopped early.
A session removed since the last pass answers session-not-found with a recovery hint instead of an empty transcript.

externalDependencies.boundary: Read-only: JSONL files under <CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude>/projects/<project>/<session>.jsonl; the plugin never writes, moves or deletes them.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: fixtures/home/.claude/projects holds a synthetic Claude Code log (meta prompt, streamed message, tool use and result, ai-title, a malformed line, a subagent log that must stay out).

externalDependencies.boundary: Read-only: rollout JSONL files under <CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex>/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/; the plugin never writes, moves or deletes them.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: fixtures/home/.codex/sessions holds a synthetic Codex rollout (session_meta, context messages, reasoning, function call and output, cumulative token counts).
